## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), see CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `npm test` passes in `backend/` and `frontend/`
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes in `backend/` and `frontend/`
- [ ] New or changed endpoints keep bars apart (a user of one bar can't reach another bar's data)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under the next version, if users or self-hosters notice the change
